text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under overwhelming attention, Ramonu ran a 
magnificent race. Seeing her satisfied 
smile, the Trainer realized. What they 
"wanted to know most" as a Trainer was—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why did she run? Because she loved racing. 
She had known the answer all along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, the two set their next 
immediate goal: the Hanshin Juvenile 
Fillies, where many Umamusume on the Tiara 
route will compete.
